stories.headline: Community LoRA for MiniMax-H3 adds martial-arts action motion
stories.body: A user-published LoRA (Jojocodex/wushu-action-v7) fine-tunes MiniMax-H3 for wushu/martial-arts action sequences, supporting image-to-video and reference-to-video with first/last frame control. It has notable traction (14.5k downloads) which signals the MiniMax-H3 ComfyUI ecosystem is still growing, but this specific LoRA is a narrow niche asset with an 'other' licence that needs checking before any studio use.
stories.why: Confirms MiniMax-H3's open ecosystem is active, but the LoRA itself has no production relevance.

stories.headline: ComfyUI v0.37.0 released with disk-speed auto-detection and partner node fixes
stories.body: ComfyUI's latest release adds auto-detection for fast disks to enable --fast-disk mode, transparent background support for GPT Image 2 via OpenAI partner nodes, CFG control for the YuE2 music node, and a fix preventing empty GLB/FBX outputs from Tripo nodes. Text encoder now stays on GPU when dynamic VRAM is enabled. Open source, free to deploy.
stories.why: Direct pipeline-relevant update for any studio already running ComfyUI nodes in production.

stories.headline: Chaos details ICX and profile-guided optimization work in V-Ray
stories.body: Chaos published a technical writeup, co-authored with Intel engineers, on ICX and profile-guided optimization (PGO) improvements in V-Ray for Maya. The piece covers engineering rationale and performance methodology rather than a specific shipped feature or benchmark number. No pricing or version details given.
stories.why: Renderer performance work worth tracking if V-Ray is in the pipeline, but thin on shippable specifics.
